shift_simulation.convention: zero-state step shift at run 1; weekly subgroups cycle through the observed weekly sizes from a random start week; detection probability is P(first signal in the direction of the shift within h runs); at ratio 1 any signal counts, as a false alarm

laney_p_prime_phase1_sigma.label: weekly Laney p′, Phase I-centred σ_z

cusum_upper_matched.label: Bernoulli CUSUM, upper, matched to p-chart

cusum_lower_matched.label: Bernoulli CUSUM, lower, matched to g-chart

segmentation.rule: split a segment while its block-permutation p < 0.05; segments shorter than 60 runs are not tested
